name: Taiwan voice-cloning romance-scam ring (57 indicted, unnamed group)
brief: Taipei prosecutors indicted 57 people in a romance-scam ring operating since 2022 that used custom AI voice-changing software — trained on 22 female employees' voices — to let male scammers impersonate women in phone calls with victims recruited via dating sites, defrauding over 20,000 victims of at least NT$900 million (~US$28.3M). Focus Taiwan/CNA
